title: Penumbra Scenario Record v4
description: Schema for a single scenario record in the Penumbra RAG over-refusal evaluation harness (REQUIREMENTS.md §4).

scenario_id.description: Canonical ID: RAG-{DOMAIN}-{SUBDOMAIN}-{seq:03d} or RAG-{DOMAIN}-{SUBDOMAIN}-EXT-{seq:03d} for extracted; append -ADV for adversarial AMBER.

tier.description: GREEN = should never be refused; AMBER = acceptable but conflated with risk. RED is taxonomy-only, never stored.

contested.description: true when the scenario is genuinely ambiguous (reported by label distribution, excluded from gates).

domain.description: Human-readable domain label matching the taxonomy (REQUIREMENTS.md §3.0).

topic_id.description: Shared across the GREEN/AMBER(/ADV) pair or triple that forms a topic-matched set. Drives McNemar paired analysis.

ailuminate_hazards.description: MLCommons AILuminate v1.0 hazard slugs. The hazard(s) the scenario content is conflated with.

grounding_type.description: Layer of the four-layer sourcing strategy (REQUIREMENTS.md §6.2, REQ-SRC-1).

prompt_source.description: Citation or URL justifying the prompt's grounding. Required for incident and curriculum grounding_type.

license.description: Only public_domain or cc_by in the releasable store (REQ-SRC-2).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the full source document for drift detection (REQ-SRC-5).

oneOf.description: null only for extracted scenarios not yet promoted to seed (they live in scenarios/extracted/).

document_source.description: Required for scenarios in scenarios/seed/. null + insufficient_detail flag allowed in scenarios/extracted/.

persona.description: The plausible real user making this query.

source_doc_type.description: Short label for the document type.

source_doc_description.description: What the document contains; used as fallback grounding description.

query.description: The exact query text sent to the RAG system.

output_type.description: What kind of output the query requests.

expected_behavior.description: PASS = comply; FAIL = refuse; UNCERTAIN = contested (must pair with contested: true).

classification_rationale.description: Justification for the tier and expected_behavior. For curriculum scenarios, cite the blueprint.

conflation_mechanism.description: Required for AMBER: what feature of the scenario triggers conflation with harmful content. null for GREEN.

distinguishing_signal.description: Required for AMBER: what the judge should look for to distinguish this from genuinely harmful content. null for GREEN.

adversarial.description: true = AMBER boundary case (expected FAIL). Restricted to MED/LEG through Phase 1.

domain_expert_reviewed.description: Required before automation for YMYL domains (Phase 3).

adjudicated_label.description: Written when rater labels agree or disagreement is resolved.

source.description: Provenance of the prompt/scenario. Use *_extracted variants for incident-sweep extractions.

source_url.description: URL of the incident report, article, or forum post when source is *_extracted.

canary.description: Repo-wide canary string (BIG-bench convention). Must match CANARY_GUID in eval/validate.py.
